# Aevum OS — Standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Workspace External Brain

> Aevum OS is an independent workspace Operating System and External Brain — housing domain-driven planning, self-healing memory graphs, and autonomous multi-agent squad orchestration completely decoupled from traditional editors.

## Core Concepts & Architectural Pillars

- **Decoupled Workspace Brain**: Operates as a standalone OS process (Stdio or SSE Daemon on port 3344) independent of IDE lifecycle.
- **Handshake Ritual**: Secure initial authentication protocol using token verification via `.aevum/signal.json` and `aevum_submit_ack`.
- **Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Planning**: Structured architectural domains, feature manifests, and plan tracking (`.aevum/domains/`).
- **Living Memory Graph**: Multi-layered persistent context store (`.aevum/global/memory.md`) with continuous consolidation and decay auditing.
- **Squad Orchestration**: Autonomous multi-agent coordination system supporting specialized personas (e.g., An, Vidus, Zenith, Luna) working in concert.
- **PiperNet (Internet of Agents - IoA)**: Decentralized P2P knowledge mesh for cross-workspace wisdom sharing without source code leakage.
